properties.name: jfoundry.web.rest-client.logging.level
properties.description: Outbound RestClient logging detail: NONE, BASIC, HEADERS, or FULL. Logging is emitted at INFO when enabled.

properties.name: jfoundry.web.rest-client.logging.format
properties.description: Outbound RestClient logging layout: HUMAN for Feign-style --> request and <-- response lines, with bodies on one line and END HTTP closers; INLINE for one-line key=value events.

properties.name: jfoundry.web.rest-client.logging.included-headers
properties.description: Header names included in outbound RestClient logs when HEADERS or FULL is enabled. The configured list replaces the default. Use * to include every header after redaction.
